Logistic Regression
-----------------------
- Classification Algorithm
    - Binary Class Classification -> Logistic Regression
    - Multi Class Classification

Stratify
-----------
- We only need to stratify Target Data (Y).
- To send equal % of data to both training and testing data not to make model biasness.
- 70% -> Healthy, 30% -> Unhealthy

80/20 split

Training Target Data
----------------------
Healthy -> 70% -> 40%
Unhealthy -> 30% -> 40%

Testing Target Data
---------------------
Healthy -> 70% -> 10%
Unhealthy -> 30% -> 10%

X_train, X_test, Y_train, Y_test = train_test_split(
    X, Y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=Y
)

Logistic Model
--------------------
Arguments for model
    - solver -> liblinear, lbfgs (default), saga
    - class_weight -> None (default), balanced
    - random_state -> 42

Metrics
----------
- classification report
- confusion matrix
